audit_metadata.title: CASCADE Final Compatibility Review Before Any Staging

contract_modifications_vs_head.synthetic_data_removal: Deleted hardcoded DENSE_CLINICAL_DATASET and DenseEmbeddingGenerator (hash-based TF-IDF projection).
contract_modifications_vs_head.score_bonuses_eliminated: Removed artificial +0.45 organ bonus and +0.35 severity bonus.
contract_modifications_vs_head.similarity_score_return_type: Returns float (genuine cosine similarity) when index query succeeds; returns None when unconfigured or offline (previously defaulted to 0.95).

medical_agent_py.none_guarding: Explicit check: 'if sim_score is not None: ... else: sim_score_str = "Not Available (Guideline retrieval index unconfigured or offline)"'. Safely handles None without TypeError or crash.
medical_agent_py.kb_references_guarding: Fallback to 'No matching guidelines retrieved' when kb_refs is empty.

app_py.consumption_site: Delegates multi-agent board calls to medical_agent; does not directly access similarity_score.

templates_index_html.ui_presentation: Displays truthful offline message: 'Status: Research output — no authenticated clinical review recorded' and 'Not Available'. No synthetic 0.95 or fake confidence displayed.

gate_1_pinecone_rag_engine_compatibility.live_connectivity_claim: No live Pinecone connection is claimed. Safely operates in verified offline/unconfigured state.

contract_modifications_vs_head.path_discovery: Replaced hardcoded data/separated_scans with configurable data_dir argument and CASCADE_DATA_DIR env fallback.
contract_modifications_vs_head.terminology_change: Replaced 'severity' distribution keys ('Normal', 'Mild Anomaly', 'High Risk') with Candidate ROI status keys ('Candidate ROI Detected', 'No Candidate ROI Flagged').
contract_modifications_vs_head.paired_metric_guard: PSNR and SSIM gains are computed only when clean ground-truth references exist in clean/ (paired_images_count > 0); prevents None addition errors.

downstream_consumer_audit.dependent_modules: None. Zero other python files import or invoke validate_models_on_dataset.
downstream_consumer_audit.reporting_nature: Strictly reports candidate ROI detection rates as spatial flags, explicitly disclaiming disease diagnosis or clinical risk triage.
downstream_consumer_audit.empty_data_behavior: Gracefully prints '[!] No images found to validate' and returns cleanly without exception.

contract_modifications_vs_head.path_discovery: Configurable via --data-dir and CASCADE_DATA_DIR environment variable.
contract_modifications_vs_head.reproducibility: Added random.seed(42) for deterministic slice sampling; replaces unseeded random.shuffle.
contract_modifications_vs_head.output_behavior: Strictly outputs to stdout (print statements). Zero file writes to disk; cannot overwrite existing files or modify medical data.

downstream_consumer_audit.empty_data_behavior: Gracefully prints '[!] No images found to evaluate' and returns cleanly.

gate_5_verification_and_regression_evide.git_diff_check: PASS (Exit code 0, clean whitespace and formatting)

validation_report_side_effect_audit.empty_dataset_behavior: Returns early at line 103 without opening or truncating the output file.

destructive_utilities_policy.execute_safe_cleanup_py: EXCLUDE_FROM_AUTOMATIC_STAGING (Requires explicit repository owner review and instruction prior to committing any file-deletion utility)
